policy: PR 340 guards live in this sidecar so they do not share the closing bracket of qa/regressions.json. The runner reads every qa/regressions-*.json file.

regressions.failure: Marks for a spoken sentence could appear on a guessed word rate, a late audio cue could be applied again, or cancel could still release marks.
Apply returned a mark whose timestamp was still in the future, so it could show before its audio.
A mark with no start never became due and never expired.
Barge-in did not cancel the mark schedule, so later audio could still reveal marks.
The 0.18 s per word estimate was unused, so a mark with no real time had no disclosed fallback.
